int_name: W INDIANA AVE & N WOODSTOCK ST

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While the narrow street width naturally limits vehicle speeds, the presence of parked cars near corners and the lack of formal crossing points create safety risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the intersection, reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped curb transitions makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: All visible corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner on the right side may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a typical residential row-house street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of pedestrian-specific safety infrastructure. The wide, unmarked roadway and continuous street parking create visibility issues and may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations without priority.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous street parking on both sides limits sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a wide street can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at intersections to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This is a narrow, one-way residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. While the narrow street geometry naturally limits vehicle speeds, the environment lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A large grill, planters, and a traffic cone are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the accessible path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left on the sidewalk in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks visible, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas without clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the asphalt roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while providing shade.
